fields.spec_mechanism_excerpt: ## Signal and timing - Spread z from rolling log price ratio (duration carry proxy). - Formation window ends at *t−1*; signal at completed daily close *t*. ## Two-leg execution (Alpaca paper) When carry is rich, this spec **requires both legs**: **buy VGIT** and **short SHY** on the same signal day. Alpaca paper supports US equity short selling when `shorting_enabled` is true. **SHY** and **VGIT** are treated as easy-to-borrow Treasury ETFs on paper. If paper rejects systematic **short SHY** fills, treat as **disconfirmer** — do not promote on long-only VGIT proxy. ## Universe and horizon - **Symbols:** **VGIT**, **SHY** only. - **Bar interval:** 1Day. - **Signal:** When log(VGIT/SHY) z-score ≥ +1 vs 63-day history → **long VGIT**, **short SHY**; else flat both legs.
fields.spec_validation_proof_excerpt: ## Validation and promotion proof Alpaca paper **two-leg** forward only — not backtest replay as Gate 3 proof. ## Costs Manifest `data/manifests/vgit-shy-term-carry-1d-alpaca.yaml`. ## Disconfirmers | Disconfirmer | Interpretation | |--------------|----------------| | Promotion cites **live Alpaca host** or **crypto perp funding** proof | Venue violation — kill. |
